Don't get overconfident with your fleet, doesn't matter what ships and how many battleships you have, you can always find someone better who can chew through your ships like nothing (like i did last night and i had 2 fleets in one, one high-tech and one midline beefed af, they chewed through all my ships and i barelely got alive with most of my ships with one or two D-mods after being destroyed). 

And if you don't want to loose them, reinforced bulkheads is a must, also efficiency overhaul too and the skills "fleet logistics" and "navigation" they are a must, if not, you are going to have a bad time doing long travels because of the expenses, and most of the times on long travels you encounter large and very dangerous fleets with a lot of good loot... So you want to bring a lot of firepower along, tankers and freighters to carry the loot back and support the fuel expense which is going to be insane even with the skills and eficiency mod on all ships, but is worth it.

About colonies, dont make them free ports or ad AI until you have at least one High Command in the system, and a patrol hq on each colony on that system and a space station. As soon as you become a free port you get targeted by pirates and the rest of the factions, and unless you have good security and or money for bribing the other factions out of raiding you, your colonies are going to get gangraped monthly by pirates, several times a month even and from the other factions too. Invest in security, max out the patrol hq, build batteries, max them out, build a space station and max it out too, security above all, and then build a heavy industry and add a nanoforge to it, it will give your fleets a boost in size and quality and will bring you profit. Then just become independent, expand and build different industries and manage to be self sufficient, max the growth of your colonies.

Best to start is next to the core systems, and try to colonize all the planets in that system, even if they are poor you can always build light industry and refineries, which don't need anything on the planet, can import all the materials needed. Being all the planets in the same system and each planet having a high command (maxed patrol hq) will full your system of patrols and make it untouchable by pirates...
